__comment: Misc identity/classification fixes (2026-07-23): botanicals get their curated active-constituent SMILES from generatedSmiles.json plus botanical_name; alcohol/nitrous get their real single-molecule chemistry; verified research-chemical fills for modafiendz, bk-2C-I (k-2c-i), BOH-2C-B (h-2c-b), and 4-fluorophenibut. ayahuasca and lean are deliberately left structure-free: they are multi-constituent preparations with no single defining molecule. Fill-only via scripts/convex/backfill-identification.mjs.

provenance.alcohol: Ethanol, PubChem CID 702; psychoactive_class per phenibut/benzo depressant precedent.
provenance.nitrous: Nitrous oxide, PubChem CID 948; psychoactive_class per dissociative convention (ketamine).
provenance.salvia: Salvinorin A constituent SMILES from generatedSmiles.json (CID 128563); Atypical Hallucinogen per 5-meo-dmt/zolpidem precedent tag.
provenance.tobacco: Nicotine constituent SMILES from generatedSmiles.json (CID 89594). chemical_class left empty: no existing pyridine-alkaloid tag; flagged for editorial.
provenance.kanna: Mesembrine constituent SMILES from generatedSmiles.json (CID 394162). chemical_class left empty: no existing mesembrine-alkaloid tag; flagged for editorial.
provenance.datura: Scopolamine constituent SMILES from generatedSmiles.json; classes and botanical_name already populated.
provenance.n-methylbisfluoromodafinil: Modafiendz verified vs FDA GSRS UNII 223VWC34TA and PubChem CID 132989661 (web research 2026-07-23); psychoactive_class matches armodafinil.
provenance.k-2c-i: Article prose identifies subject as βk-2C-I; structure per PubChem CID 165361441 and Texter et al., Drug Testing and Analysis 2017. CAS unresolved, left empty.
provenance.h-2c-b: Article prose identifies subject as βH-2C-B (BOH-2C-B); structure per curated generatedSmiles entry, PubChem CID 11370394.
provenance.f-phenibut: 4-fluorophenibut, PubChem CID 103611, CAS 52237-19-1; psychoactive_class matches phenibut. Canonical slug kept (richer article).
provenance.fluorophenibut: Duplicate of f-phenibut (same CID 103611); filled for correctness but demoted to low priority.
provenance.sertraline: Tetrahydronaphthalenamine core; reuses existing 'Naphthalene derivative' tag (propranolol precedent).
